command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp

# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).

# WHY BUILD RATHER THAN FETCH. 1000genomes publishes a prebuilt *bwa* index beside this
# reference but no .bt2. bowtie2's own published indexes are built on DIFFERENT references
# (GRCh38_noalt_as / _noalt_decoy_as), and aligning to a different reference than bwa used
# would turn the bwa-vs-bowtie2 cross-check into a method difference masquerading as a
# disagreement. So the index is built on bwa-real's exact staged reference, once, and reused
# by every rung of the sweep.

echo "== the reference must be the exact bytes bwa-real aligned against =="
ls -l GRCh38_full_analysis_set_plus_decoy_hla.fa
SZ=$(stat -c %s GRCh38_full_analysis_set_plus_decoy_hla.fa)
echo "ref_bytes	$SZ"
test "$SZ" = "3263683042" || { echo "FAIL: reference is $SZ bytes, 1000genomes publishes 3263683042"; exit 1; }

bowtie2-build --version | head -2
nproc | awk '{print "nproc\t"$1}'

echo "== bowtie2-build, whole genome (the long pole of this batch) =="
T0=$(date +%s)
bowtie2-build --threads "$(nproc)" \
  GRCh38_full_analysis_set_plus_decoy_hla.fa GRCh38_fadh > /tmp/bt2build.log 2>&1
RC=$?
T1=$(date +%s)
echo "build_rc	$RC"
echo "build_wall_s	$((T1-T0))"
tail -5 /tmp/bt2build.log
test "$RC" = "0" || { echo "FAIL: bowtie2-build exited $RC"; exit 1; }

# A completion sentinel beats a size band: bowtie2-inspect reading the index back is the
# tool's own statement that what was written is a loadable index, not merely N bytes.
echo "== bowtie2-inspect must read the index back =="
bowtie2-inspect -s GRCh38_fadh > /tmp/bt2inspect.txt 2>&1
IRC=$?
echo "inspect_rc	$IRC"
test "$IRC" = "0" || { echo "FAIL: the index does not load"; exit 1; }
head -4 /tmp/bt2inspect.txt

# The reference has 3366 sequences (primary + alt + decoy + HLA). bowtie2-inspect reports
# one Sequence- line per contig, so this ties the index back to the reference it came from.
NSEQ=$(grep -c '^Sequence-' /tmp/bt2inspect.txt)
echo "index_sequences	$NSEQ"
test "$NSEQ" -gt 3000 || { echo "FAIL: index holds only $NSEQ sequences"; exit 1; }

ls -l GRCh38_fadh*.bt2* | awk '{print "idxfile\t"$9"\t"$5}'

# One flat tar so the consuming tasks stage a single pinnable artifact. The .bt2 files were
# created by this task, so removing them after is allowed -- unlike a staged input, which
# the container cannot unlink (sticky /tmp, EPERM).
echo "== tar the index to one flat artifact =="
tar -cf GRCh38_fadh.bt2.tar GRCh38_fadh*.bt2*
tar -tf GRCh38_fadh.bt2.tar | awk '{print "tar_member\t"$1}'
rm -f GRCh38_fadh*.bt2*
ls -l GRCh38_fadh.bt2.tar
sha256sum GRCh38_fadh.bt2.tar | tee GRCh38_fadh.bt2.tar.sha256

df -k /tmp | awk 'NR==2{printf "tmpfs_used_mib\t%.0f\n", $3/1024}'
echo "BOWTIE2 INDEX OK"
